Class WaitingViewController

java.lang.Object
view.WaitingViewController
All Implemented Interfaces:
SceneController, ViewController
public class WaitingViewController extends Object implements SceneController
Shown after the player joined a lobby that is not yet full. Leave returns to the lobby list; once the server sends a game state with the COLOR_CHOOSING_PHASE, the router replaces this scene with the board.
